title: Rosmarinic Acid Ameliorates Type 2 Diabetic Osteoporosis by Reducing NLRP3 Expression and Alleviating Osteoblast Pyroptosis via the FOXO1/TXNIP Signaling Pathway.
authors: Feng, Sixiang; Ma, Runxun; Huang, Yixun; Pan, Libo; Guo, Yangfan; Wang, Yikai; Chen, Zihao; Li, Enli; Bu, Yitian; Luo, Jian; Tang, Jiahao; Yang, Lei
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究迷迭香酸通过FOXO1/TXNIP信号通路改善糖尿病骨质疏松，属于细胞信号通路与疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Unlike postmenopausal osteoporosis, Type 2 diabetic osteoporosis (T2DOP) occurs in a chronic high-glucose, inflammatory microenvironment, increasing fracture risk. Emerging evidence links osteoblast pyroptosis to T2DOP pathogenesis. While rosmarinic acid (RA) exhibits antidiabetic and anti-inflammatory properties, its role in T2DOP remains unclear. We established a T2DOP mouse model using a high-fat diet and low-dose STZ, confirmed by micro-CT. RA's effects on osteoblast function and mitochondrial homeostasis were evaluated, with network pharmacology and molecular docking identifying potential targets. In vivo validation was performed through RA administration. Results showed pyroptosis activation and NLRP3 upregulation in T2DOP bone tissue. RA enhanced osteoblast proliferation, reduced pyroptosis, promoted mineralization, and mitigated mitochondrial dysfunction. The FOXO1/TXNIP pathway was identified as a key target, with RA suppressing NLRP3 activation via FOXO1/TXNIP modulation. This effect was reversed by FOXO1 inhibitor AS1842856. In vivo, RA preserved bone mass and microarchitecture in T2DOP mice. RA protects osteoblasts by improving mitochondrial function and inhibiting NLRP3-mediated pyroptosis through FOXO1/TXNIP signaling, offering a potential T2DOP treatment strategy.
abstract_zh: 与绝经后骨质疏松症不同，2型糖尿病性骨质疏松症（T2DOP）发生在慢性高糖、炎症性微环境中，增加骨折风险。新兴证据将成骨细胞焦亡与T2DOP发病机制联系起来。尽管迷迭香酸（RA）具有抗糖尿病和抗炎特性，但其在T2DOP中的作用仍不清楚。我们使用高脂饮食和低剂量STZ建立了T2DOP小鼠模型，并通过micro-CT确认。评估了RA对成骨细胞功能和线粒体稳态的影响，利用网络药理学和分子对接识别潜在靶点。通过RA给药进行了体内验证。结果显示，T2DOP骨组织中焦亡激活和NLRP3上调。RA增强了成骨细胞增殖，减少了焦亡，促进了矿化，并缓解了线粒体功能障碍。FOXO1/TXNIP通路被确定为关键靶点，RA通过调节FOXO1/TXNIP抑制NLRP3激活。这一效应被FOXO1抑制剂AS1842856逆转。在体内，RA保留了T2DOP小鼠的骨量和微结构。RA通过改善线粒体功能和抑制NLRP3介导的焦亡（经由FOXO1/TXNIP信号通路）保护成骨细胞，为T2DOP治疗提供了潜在策略。
